newsitem.title: USA: Enzon gets $1 mln know-how payment.
newsitem.headline: Enzon gets $1 mln know-how payment.

text.p: Enzon Inc said it has completed the transfer of know-how for the manufacture of Peg-Intron A to Schering Corp, a Schering-Plough Corp subsidiary, and has received a payment of $1 million.

In 1995, Schering and Enzon amended their existing agreement to include the transfer of Enzon's Peg-Intron A know-how and worldwide manufacturing rights to Schering for $3 million, of which $2 million was paid last year. At that time, Schering invested $2 million in Enzon's common stock.

"This payment, along with the company's already low burn rate, should allow us to complete another quarter without a substantial change in our cash position," stated Enzon chief executive Peter G. Tombros.
